summary: Guest query API path: real answer, cost tracked to guest_queries, no user/session/budget writes
description: Depends on the guest primitive + guest_queries migration. Dedicated POST /api/query/guest sharing retrieval+prompt+stream helpers with /api/query (extract shared machinery). Pin free-tier defaults: DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG model, DEFAULT_VOICE (scholar), default retrieval scope — full corpus retrieval + citations, real streamed answer (must NOT feel like a demo). Enforce guest-token one-shot + guest:<ip> throttle up front (429 when exhausted). Compute cost from the usage chunk exactly like the authed path (computeCost) and INSERT one guest_queries row with query/response/tokens/cost_usd/ip/ip_name. Do NOT call reserveBudget/finalizeBudget, do NOT write users/sessions/queries rows. Optional backstop noted in a follow-up: global daily guest-spend cap via SUM(cost_usd) today.
